source_notes: Batch settings are explicit launcher profiles, not a proven mapping to each reported rounded value.
NoPE/XPos default to named legacy absolute-position compatibility; --correct-nope selects intended position-free behavior.
The user confirmed 200M was a post-paper change; the main experiment uses the paper budget of 100M tokens.
The sampler uses an independent saved seed/cursor; historical script RNG consumption is not asserted identical.

Fixed sigma values come from paper-matching historical validation logs. Layer threshold3 implements the current paper four/four hierarchy; five historical C4 runs instead used threshold4 (five/three).
Wiki20M/L512 length is inferred from the 100M budget, 3051 steps and global batch64; the model count and sigma200/threshold3 are explicit in the log.
User-authorized L2048 sigma700/800/900/1000 search. All non-sigma training settings are unchanged. Complete matching sigma700 runs are reused rather than duplicated.
